definitions.explanation: A formal telegram sent to express condolences upon someone's death. A customary practice in Japan when one cannot attend a funeral in person.

examples.japanese: {弔電|ちょうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{弔電|ちょうでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}まれた→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Condolence telegrams were read at the funeral.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遠方|えんぽう}→遠方：19464_enpou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{参列|さんれつ}→参列：11888_sanretsu⟧⟦でき→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ず、{弔電|ちょうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Since I was too far away to attend, I decided to send a condolence telegram.

notes:
Composed of {弔|ちょう} (mourning) + {電|でん} (telegram). Like ⟦{祝電|しゅくでん}→祝電：22862_shukuden⟧, condolence telegrams remain an active custom in Japan. They are typically read aloud during funeral ceremonies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弔電|ちょうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send a condolence telegram
- {弔電|ちょうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to send a condolence telegram (lit. "strike")
- {弔電|ちょうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる→読み上げる：04604_yomiageru⟧: to read aloud a condolence telegram
- {弔電|ちょうでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: a condolence telegram arrives

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{祝電|しゅくでん}→祝電：22862_shukuden⟧: congratulatory telegram — sent for happy occasions, the opposite
- ⟦{弔辞|ちょうじ}→弔辞：22501_chouji⟧: eulogy — a spoken tribute at a funeral
- ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧: condolence money — monetary offering given at funerals
